thesis: Decision-critical operating, cash, leverage, capex, backlog, utilization and legal facts are filing-backed. Main uncertainty lies in normalized cycle margins/FCF and the approximate valuation percentile.

evidence.claim: FY2025 filing supports multi-year financials, OCF, capex, R&D and year-end backlog.
H1 filing supports revenue, profit, backlog, customer concentration, utilization, cash/debt and legal disclosures.
Current price/valuation inputs are cross-checked against public market sources.

counterevidence: 5Y valuation percentile is a proxy, not a full daily calculation.
DCF paths and normalized margins are estimates.
falsifiers: Any later filing materially restating frozen facts requires a rerun.
next_checks: Replace percentile proxy and update legal/capacity evidence at FY2026.
